stream-tile.$description: The square form of the stream tile for covers and station logos (concept 18, 17.3): the picture in the middle on a blurred, darkened copy of itself.

ground-blur.$description: Blur radius of the ground behind a square cover or logo.

ground-dim.$description: Brightness of the blurred ground (1 = unchanged): dark enough for the badges on it.

control.$description: Component tokens (concept 12, ADR 0020): what the ui building blocks read instead of the general scale. The default is today's value; density.compact holds the administration's values.

height.$description: Height of buttons, inputs, selects, switches and checkbox rows.

padding.$description: Inner padding of panels and dialogs.

gap.$description: Gap between the children of a panel.

radius.$description: Corner radius of panels and dialogs.

cell-padding-y.$description: Vertical padding of table header and body cells.

row-height.$description: Minimum height of a body row, border included; 0: the padding and the content set it.

title-size.$description: Size of the page title (h1) from 768 px; below, titles use font.size.3xl.

title-tracking.$description: Letter spacing of the page title (h1).

title-line-height.$description: Line height of the h1 itself around its title text (AdminPage): what an h1 inherits today.

gap.$description: Gap between the sections of a page.

title-size.$description: Size of a section title (h2, SectionHeader).

gap.$description: Gap between title, body and actions of a dialog.

body-size.$description: Size of running text (Text variant body): intro sentences, hints, empty states, the save bar's status.

help-size.$description: Size of the help line under a setting's label (SettingRow).

text-gap.$description: Gap between a setting's label and its help line.

library-tile.$description: The name and the count on a library tile of «Meine Medien» (concept 18 C-2, Marco chose 26 px).

label-size.$description: 26 px: the name at its full size.

label-size-min.$description: 20 px: the least size of the name on a narrow tile (a phone).

label-size-fluid.$description: The name between the two sizes follows the tile's width (a container query unit).

count-size.$description: 14 px: the number of titles under the name.

compact.$description: Compact density of the administration's content and dialogs (concept 12, 5.1). web/src/ui/density.css maps these onto the component tokens under [data-shell="admin"] with (min-width: 48rem) and (pointer: fine); touch and phones keep 44 px.

height.$description: 32 px: below the 44 px touch recommendation, above WCAG 2.2 AA 2.5.8 (24 px); for a fine pointer only.

cell-padding-y.$description: 6 px: room for a 24 px chip, checkbox or fold-out button (and its baseline) inside a 40 px row.

row-height.$description: 40 px (concept 12, S-5): a row of 14 px text, and one with a 24 px chip or button, is 40 px high.

title-line-height.$description: No line of the h1's own: the 24 px title sets the height (26 px), not the browser's 2em of an h1 (48 px).

gutter.$description: Side margin of the page (--page-gutter in web/src/ui/global.css: 40 px from 768 px, 64 px from 1440 px).

body-size.$description: 14 px: running text as in the mockups (13 to 14 px), the size of the setting rows' labels.

help-size.$description: 12 px like the mockups (Int-A, Spo-A, Met-B): a setting with one line of help is about 56 px high.
